## Triage — `domain:spec` · `priority:p2` · type `Bug`. `finding` leaves in the same write.

Triage seat (`session_01KYzNJPin9Ar4oMMkSh4S9h`), 2026-09-20T14:51Z. Card came in bare (`finding` only).

### Lane — read from the body's named landing point, ⛔ not from the title

`packages/spec/src/ui/action.zod.ts` (the `undoable` declaration) with `packages/runtime/src/action-execution.ts` as the consuming side. The contract half is the spec's.

### Grade — `p2`

An `undoable: true` written without `operation` is **accepted and silently un-anchored** — the author gets no refusal and no undo. That is 〈优先级〉4's named failure verbatim: 「错的必须被响亮拒绝并给处方,**永不静默落库**」. It is a class-(c) metadata trap: the key is stored, re-authored by someone else, and does nothing.

`p2` and ⛔ not `p1`: the platform runs and the rest of the action works — what is wrong is one key's outcome. 「能跑但出错 ⇒ P2」.


Path: P3 | 那条路第 3 步「验证响亮拒绝错的」 | `undoable` 缺 `operation` 被静默接受

## Why this card, and why it is not barred by North Star rule 3

Rule 3 bars **p2/p3 工具卡与契约卫生卡** while the product repo has open P0/P1 — and it does: **4** open P0, **43** open P1 at this reading. ⭐ This card is neither. Its own first line puts it on **Path P3 —「验证响亮拒绝错的」**, and the defect is product-visible authoring behaviour: an author writes `undoable: true` with no `operation`, the document parses clean, and nothing undoes anything. That is the North Star's 「错的必须被响亮拒绝并给处方,⛔ 永不静默落库」, ⛔ not ledger tidying and ⛔ not a gate repair.

⚠️ **All three p1 cards in this lane were checked first and all three are genuinely held** — ⛔ this is not a p2 taken in preference to available p1 work:

|---|---|
| **#17667** | PR #19373 holds `packages/spec/src/api/package-api.zod.ts`, its exact target file |
| **#19365** | the linked sibling of #17667 — 被链接或同父的两单永不同批, and it depends on the same retirement shape |
| **#19289** | region-held by PR #18319 on `packages/lint/src/**` (7 files). Re-measured and recorded at `5752285669` |

## Serial constraint — measured at claim time, ⛔ not inherited

This card's surface is exactly two files, both named in its body:

```
packages/spec/src/ui/action.zod.ts
packages/runtime/src/action-execution.ts
```

All **21** open PRs read, `GET /pulls/N/files` per PR, intersected against that surface.

- **EXACT-file holders: NONE.**
- **0 unreadable file lists** ⇒ ⛔ no false zero hiding behind a failed fetch.
- **Lit control on the same run:** `packages/spec/src/api/package-api.zod.ts` resolves to PR #19373, a hold this seat independently knows to be live. The instrument discriminates.

Three PRs share a *directory* with this surface and ⛔ none shares a file: **#19090** (`ui/bulk-action.*`), **#19398** (`ui/component.*`, `ui/dataset.zod.ts`, `ui/view.zod.ts`), **#18319** (six `packages/runtime/src/**` **test** files). ⇒ **Not a collision.** The charter's test is stated in `core-rules.md`: 「同批独立性按**文件面不相交**判,⛔ 不按包」, and `SKILL.md` adds 「区域写不清就只能整文件串行」 — the fallback is file-level, and at file level these sets are disjoint. Residual overlap, if any appears, 「冲突交合并队列仲裁 ⛔ 不手排」.

⚠️ This reading decays. Anyone inheriting this card re-takes it before their own claim write, ⛔ never quotes this one.

## Clause-② — `yes (narrowing)`, declared before any commit

The repair makes `ActionSchema` **refuse** a combination it accepts today (`undoable: true` with no `operation`). An accept set that shrinks is a narrowing, and the ruling of record on that family is `5725370319` on #17852 — 「accept-set narrowing ⇒ `Clause-②: yes`；spec lane at-tier review」. ⇒ this PR carries `needs:contract-review` on **both** carriers and lands only on an at-tier PASS. ⛔ This seat is below `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` and will ⛔ not review it itself.

## Premise re-verified on today's tip, ⛔ not inherited from the card

The card's measurement was taken at `889d9c7f` (PR #19283, card #19148). **PR #19283 has since MERGED** (2026-09-20T11:03:35Z), so the premise had to be re-read rather than carried: #19283 rewrote the `undoable` `.describe()` text and ⛔ did not add an enforcement, which is exactly what the card says it does not close. The two named files are on `origin/main` and no open PR holds either.

— `domain:spec` seat 3

## Dispatch closed without code — the premise is falsified, and one thing I declared on this card is WITHDRAWN

`domain:spec` seat 3 (seat post #18883), at 2026-09-20T20:15Z. The dev I dispatched at 2026-09-20T20:01Z wrote **no implementation** and did not pick a direction. ⭐ That is the right outcome and it is what the dispatch order asked for verbatim — 「If the premise does not hold on today's tip, ⛔ stop and report that to me instead of inventing work」 and 「If your measurement says the refusal direction is wrong, ⛔ do not just pick the other one」.

### I re-verified every load-bearing claim myself rather than adopt the report

| claim | how I checked it | result |
|---|---|---|
| the pin | `cat .objectui-sha` | `53ded82bf7a494f54e344e19099dbf00854b8694` ✓ |
| reader 1 | `git grep -n undoable 53ded82b -- …/useConsoleActionRuntime.tsx` | `:487  if (action.undoable && obj && recId && rowRecord …)` ✓ |
| reader 2 | same, `…/views/RecordDetailView.tsx` | `:831  if (action.undoable && isThisRecord && pageRecord)` ✓ |
| neither reads `operation` | `git grep -c 'action\.operation'` on those two files at that sha | **0** and **0** ✓ |
| the ledger rests on them | `packages/spec/liveness/action.json` → `props/undoable` | `status: "live"`, and its `evidence` names those two files by path ✓ |
| the published example | `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/actions.md` | `ReassignLeadAction` = `type: 'api'` + `params` + `undoable: true`, **no `operation`**, under an `os:check` marker at `:29` ✓ |

⇒ the card's sentence 「produces no undo behaviour」 is **false as written**. It parses clean — that half stands — but the value **is** anchored, by a reader the card never looked at. The whole card is now on its face, with the falsified sentence struck in place ⛔ rather than deleted, because its framing is what this card grew from.

### ⛔ WITHDRAWN: what I wrote in my own claim `5752297564`

I declared, before any measurement of my own:

> The repair makes `ActionSchema` **refuse** a combination it accepts today… An accept set that shrinks is a narrowing

The **form** of that is still right — every live option here narrows, so `Clause-②: yes (narrowing)` will still apply to whichever lands. What I got wrong is the **substance I implied**: I wrote it as though the combination being refused were dead. It is not. The dev's ablation measured it — the blanket refusal was injected with `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor ×1, blob `40c9ff61…` → `52e7c537…`, restore proved blob-equal to HEAD with `git diff HEAD` empty), and the refusal count went **1 → 5**: it refuses `type: 'api'`, `script`, `url` **and the published skill example**, leaving only `operation: 'update'` clean.

⭐ **A narrowing is only cheap when the set it removes is empty.** I asserted the shape of the change and skipped measuring what the change would remove — which is the same error as reading one field and calling it the whole answer.

### What this card is now

`needs-user-decision`, ⛔ not `pm:dispatched`, assignee cleared — no one is working it and the state should say so. It meets the escalation threshold on its first limb: 公开契约真实分歧且规范定不了. There are **two reader populations with different anchors** — the framework runtime anchors `undoable` on `operation: 'update'`, the pinned console anchors it on the action alone — and whether the spec may encode a console dispatch fact is not something the spec can settle from inside.

Four options with measured costs, and a recommendation (**C**, with D's text correction folded in), are on the card face above. ⛔ This seat does not rule it.

### Two findings noted with a carrier, ⛔ not filed as cards

Both ride whichever PR implements the chosen direction, because that PR edits these exact lines — so neither is orphaned:

1. The `undoable` `.describe()` sentence landed by PR #19283 — 「An action with no `operation` declares no write set, so nothing anchors the capture there.」 — is measured false against the pinned console and against this repo's own liveness evidence.
2. `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/actions.md:22` attributes the snapshot to 「the runtime」; for that file's own example shape (`type: 'api'`, no `operation`) the snapshot is taken by the **console**, not the framework runtime.

### ⛔ What is NOT established

- Whether the spec **should** encode a console dispatch fact — option C's boundary. Not this seat's to rule, and ⛔ not measured.
- The console evidence is **source-level at the pinned sha**, ⛔ not a booted-app observation: `packages/console/dist` does not exist in a fresh checkout.
- Whether any gate would go red under any direction. With no diff there was nothing to derive or run. ⚠️ Named explicitly because it is a trap: `check:skill-examples` **cannot** catch option A's breakage — it is compile-only (`tsc --noEmit`), while a zod refine refusal is a **runtime** parse refusal that would surface at `defineAction` import time in a consumer.
- How many authors write `type: 'api'` + `undoable` today. ⛔ Not readable from this repo. ⭐ But this is **not** an unknown-pull card: we are measurably **teaching** the shape in a published, `os:check`-marked example, which is a known negative pull against option A rather than an absence of evidence.

— `domain:spec` seat 3
